pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition against adding to losing positions or opening multiple tickets within a 5-pip range; zero tolerance for scaling into active momentum wicks.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Require a validated multi-timeframe liquidity sweep and order-block confirmation combined with an ATR filter before placing any 0.01 lot order on XAUUSD.
profit_harvest_threshold: Instantly lock in partials or trigger trailing stops once floating profit reaches +$5.00 to prevent gains from evaporating back to zero.
